about: Model-provider lane falsifiers: each selftest entry breaks one falsify.py check, MP01 plants a wrapping add in counted_input_tokens so an overflowing repeated prefix no longer refuses, MP02-MP04 break the 60-second idle release behaviour, MP05-MP10 weaken the context-window admission tests, MP11 plants a nonzero cache size in the launched engine arguments, MP12-MP14 misreport the journal write outcome (a denied write as corrupt, a non-permission write as denied, and a denial without its operation), and MP15-MP16 bypass the shared journal write mapper at the replace and write call sites. The `did` and `wallet` commands share one provider-crate table with `provider`; PV43 maps `did` to the wallet manifest, PV44 and PV45 drop a did or wallet recovery target from PROVIDER_TARGETS, PV46 bypasses the refusal of an edit whose file does not exist, and PV47 and PV48 drop the model or the did confinement test harness target so a killed run leaves a mutated harness behind, and PV49 drops wallet's falsifier honesty test target, which wallet's list mutates (WP25). PV50 maps `capsule-identity` to the wasm-capsule manifest, and PV51-PV53 drop capsule-identity's source, test support or fixture target from PROVIDER_TARGETS, which the lab's list mutates. PV54 and PV55 remove or over-extend the failed test's own captured section that keeps a quoted child standard error out of the harness error search, and PV56-PV59 accept the end of the output as its closing delimiter, match the section header anywhere on a line, end the section at its last delimiter, remove only the first section, and PV60 lets a line that starts with the closing delimiter and goes on close a section. PV61-PV64 read the loader or Cargo marker after the section removal, accept text after the section header, and close a section at a line that ends with the closing delimiter. MP17-MP20 break the post-reap group probe for a zombie-only group on the Mac: MP17 restores the immediate EPERM failure, MP18 makes an EPERM that lasts to the deadline a bare timeout, MP19 accepts that EPERM as closure without ESRCH, and MP20 drops the deadline's closure reason; their evidence is macOS only. Files are relative to examples/agent-host. PV75-PV84 drop one of the wasm lab's ten edit and run-log recovery targets, so a killed lab run leaves that file mutated. PV85-PV95 break the unmutated baseline: the run proves each named test passes without the edit before it credits the edit, and these entries skip, accept, reorder or bypass that proof. PV96-PV105 refuse an edit path that leaves the repository as the tree stands: an absolute name, a climbing folder and a symbolic link each get a reason before any link or write, one falsifier delays the containment check until after the write, and a file planted at the temporary-file name waits for its exclusive create. PV106-PV109 cover that temporary file: an exclusive create refuses a name this run did not create, the cleanup removes only a file this run created, and the create and write come before the backup link so a refusal leaves no backup behind. PV110-PV114 drop one of the remaining recovery targets, capsule-identity's .gitignore and README.md and the lab's tools/src/run.rs, tools/src/receipt.rs and tests/lab_cid.rs, so a killed run leaves that file mutated. PV115-PV121 break startup recovery and the agent-conformance command: PV115 skips the recovery in main(), PV116 finds a backup but restores nothing, PV117 leaves the agent-conformance command unregistered, PV118 builds it with the capsule-identity manifest, and PV119-PV121 drop agent-conformance's first or last recovery target or the model state file, so a killed run leaves that file mutated. PV122 and PV123 bypass the unmutated baseline in the with-repo check: one skips it and one drops the missing tests from its reason. PV124 and PV125 drop the rule that a passing test which printed a line starting `SKIP ` did not run its check: PV124 removes the check and PV125 removes the --show-output flag that prints the line.
